stories.title: DHS is poised for a shutdown after lawmakers fail to strike a deal on funding
stories.summary: The Department of Homeland Security is on track to shut down Friday night after Congress left town without a deal to fund the department and limit the tactics of federal immigration officers.

stories.title: An Olympic miss by Mikaela Shiffrin has fed her doubters. But her story isn't done
stories.summary: Mikaela Shiffrin is the winningest Alpine ski racer ever, but she's been unable to medal in the last two Olympics. She has some barriers to overcome if she's going to succeed in Cortina.

stories.title: Trump faces off with governors ahead of next week's meeting
stories.summary: President Trump has shown a willingness to attack Democratic norms and traditions, including injecting partisanship in places typically immune to it.

stories.title: Dungeons & Dragons, long played for fun, is being explored for therapeutic potential
stories.summary: Dungeons & Dragons is known as a niche role-playing game. But now game masters are exploring whether it can also be therapeutic, for conditions ranging from anxiety to PTSD.

stories.title: Venezuela debates sweeping amnesty for political prisoners
stories.summary: After the fall of Nicolás Maduro, Venezuela's new leaders promise amnesty and reconciliation — but for hundreds still jailed and thousands facing charges, justice remains uncertain.

stories.title: What monogamy in the animal world tells us about ourselves
stories.summary: As Valentine's Day approaches, we take a look at monogamy and its alternatives among animals — including humans.
